create_mt_collater: create an MTCollater instance with a task config and exclude keys to collate AtomicData batches
collate_atomic_data_list: collate a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch using the MTCollater callable
create_dataset_task_map: build a dataset-to-task mapping from a task config that links datasets to their task levels
add_missing_attributes: add missing task attributes as infinity tensors to AtomicData objects in a batch for uniform output
data_list_collater: collate a list of AtomicData objects by adding missing attributes and converting to a batch
